title: Blood of the Other
description:
The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} this Skill, choose the parent Species your lineage comes from and, if it has any, one of its subspecies or regional origins. Its creature type or types, its lifespan, its age of adulthood and its languages are yours.

For every {{prerequis}}, you count as a character of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin. Also choose one Skill from those of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin: it is {{memorisee}} without taking up any {{memoire}} and does not have to be bought. You can no longer change it. If that Species does not fix for itself what you inherit from it, as with Undead and Scothans, settle it with the GM.

Your maximum {{energie}} is 8 plus half, rounded down, of the sum of your {{esprit}}, your {{energie}} Levels and every other source of maximum {{energie}}. A negative {{esprit}} counts in that sum. With +2 {{esprit}} and 1 {{energie}} Level, it is therefore 9 instead of 11, and with -1 {{esprit}} and 3 {{energie}} Levels, 9 instead of 10.

You cannot choose the same Species for {{CHAIRX-001}}.
